title: 1960 Family Group Portrait, Outdoor B&W Vintage Snapshot
description: A square black and white vintage snapshot featuring a multi-generational family standing outside together in August 1960. The photo includes five people: an elderly man and woman, a young couple, and a small child standing in the front holding hands with her parents. The photo margin has a print date stamp reading SEP 60 along with handwritten ink notes reading Aug - 1960.
